summary: This is a markdown documentation file that explains how to use a Project Setup component—a tool that helps developers quickly start new projects. It shows an example of the component in action and then walks through three different ways to get the project files: downloading a ZIP archive, running a generated installation script, or manually creating files yourself.

explanations.6: This imports the ProjectSetup component and two helper components (EmptyFolder and Guideline) from the project's custom component library.
explanations.19: This opens a ProjectSetup component with a folder name attribute, then nests multiple Snippet components inside it—each Snippet represents one file that will be included in the downloadable project.
explanations.72: AlertBox is a custom UI component being used to highlight a tip; 'variant="tip"' sets its styling to look like a helpful tip box.
explanations.93: This is another AlertBox component with variant="tip", used to draw attention to an important step in the generate-script workflow.
